id-20260927-news-1.title: October Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices Predicted to Rise up to 11 Percent, Singapore Oil Price Surge is the Trigger

segments.src: Harga bahan bakar minyak (BBM) nonsubsidi pada Oktober diproyeksikan naik hingga sekitar 11 persen.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices in October are projected to rise by up to around 11 percent.

segments.src: Pemicu utamanya adalah kenaikan harga acuan produk minyak olahan di Singapura, yang dikenal sebagai MOPS (*Mean of Platts Singapore*).
segments.tr: The main trigger is the increase in the benchmark price of refined oil products in Singapore, known as MOPS (*Mean of Platts Singapore*).

segments.src: Di saat yang sama, ketegangan di Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah membuat pelaku usaha transportasi dan logistik ikut mencermati dampaknya terhadap biaya operasional.
segments.tr: At the same time, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea have caused transportation and logistics business actors to closely monitor their impact on operational costs.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum proyeksi yang beredar, penjelasan singkat tentang cara harga BBM terbentuk, serta hal-hal yang perlu diperhatikan konsumen dan pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: This article summarizes circulating projections, a brief explanation of how fuel prices are formed, as well as things consumers and business actors need to pay attention to.

segments.src: Seluruh angka di bawah ini bersifat **proyeksi**, bukan pengumuman resmi.
segments.tr: All figures below are **projections**, not official announcements.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Berubah pada Harga Acuan?
segments.tr: ## What Changes in the Benchmark Price?

segments.src: Harga acuan MOPS diperkirakan naik dari sekitar **US$111,40 per barel** menjadi sekitar **US$126,70 per barel**.
segments.tr: The MOPS benchmark price is estimated to rise from around **US$111.40 per barrel** to approximately **US$126.70 per barrel**.

segments.src: Selisihnya sekitar US$15 per barel, atau kenaikan kurang lebih 14 persen.
segments.tr: The difference is about US$15 per barrel, or an increase of roughly 14 percent.

segments.src: Karena Indonesia masih mengandalkan sebagian pasokan produk BBM dan minyak mentah dari pasar internasional, pergerakan harga di Singapura sebagai pusat perdagangan minyak Asia kerap memengaruhi harga jual di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Because Indonesia still relies on some supply of fuel products and crude oil from the international market, price movements in Singapore as the center of Asian oil trading often affect domestic selling prices.

segments.src: ## Proyeksi Harga BBM Nonsubsidi
segments.tr: ## Non-Subsidized Fuel Price Projections

segments.src: Berdasarkan proyeksi tersebut, beberapa jenis BBM nonsubsidi diperkirakan berubah sebagai berikut.
segments.tr: Based on these projections, several types of non-subsidized fuel are estimated to change as follows.

segments.src: | Jenis BBM | Proyeksi Harga Oktober |
segments.tr: | Fuel Type | October Price Projection |

segments.src: | Pertamax Green 95 | sekitar Rp21.200 per liter |
segments.tr: | Pertamax Green 95 | around Rp21,200 per liter |

segments.src: | Dexlite | sekitar Rp25.000 per liter |
segments.tr: | Dexlite | around Rp25,000 per liter |

segments.src: | Pertamax | diperkirakan tetap |
segments.tr: | Pertamax | estimated to remain unchanged |

segments.src: | BBM subsidi | diperkirakan tetap |
segments.tr: | Subsidized fuel | estimated to remain unchanged |

segments.src: Kenaikan tertinggi yang disebut dalam proyeksi ini mencapai sekitar 11 persen.
segments.tr: The highest increase mentioned in this projection reaches about 11 percent.

segments.src: Besarannya bisa berbeda untuk tiap jenis BBM, bergantung pada spesifikasi produk dan komponen biaya masing-masing.
segments.tr: The amount may vary for each type of fuel, depending on product specifications and respective cost components.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, harga final di setiap wilayah dapat berbeda karena adanya perbedaan pajak daerah dan biaya distribusi.
segments.tr: It should be noted that the final price in each region may differ due to differences in local taxes and distribution costs.

segments.src: Harga resmi biasanya diumumkan badan usaha, dalam hal ini Pertamina, pada awal periode penyesuaian.
segments.tr: Official prices are usually announced by the business entity, in this case Pertamina, at the beginning of the adjustment period.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga Minyak Singapura Berpengaruh?
segments.tr: ## Why Do Singapore Oil Prices Matter?

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi tidak ditetapkan secara sembarangan.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices are not set arbitrarily.

segments.src: Secara umum, harga jual dipengaruhi beberapa komponen:
segments.tr: In general, selling prices are influenced by several components:

segments.src: - **Harga acuan produk (MOPS atau indeks setara):** menjadi dasar biaya pengadaan BBM.
segments.tr: - **Product benchmark price (MOPS or equivalent index):** serves as the basis for fuel procurement costs.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar AS:** karena transaksi minyak menggunakan dolar, pelemahan rupiah dapat menambah biaya.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar:** because oil transactions use dollars, the weakening of the rupiah can increase costs.

segments.src: - **Biaya distribusi dan penyimpanan:** mencakup pengangkutan hingga sampai ke SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Distribution and storage costs:** covers transportation until it reaches the gas station.

segments.src: - **Pajak dan margin badan usaha:** termasuk pajak pertambahan nilai dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor.
segments.tr: - **Taxes and business entity margins:** including value-added tax and motor vehicle fuel tax.

segments.src: Ketika harga acuan naik cukup tajam dalam waktu singkat, tekanan terhadap harga jual pun ikut membesar, terutama pada produk yang harganya mengikuti mekanisme pasar.
segments.tr: When the benchmark price rises quite sharply in a short time, pressure on the selling price also increases, especially for products whose prices follow market mechanisms.

segments.src: ## Pertamax dan BBM Subsidi Diperkirakan Tetap
segments.tr: ## Pertamax and Subsidized Fuel Estimated to Remain Unchanged

segments.src: Kabar yang relatif melegakan bagi banyak pengguna kendaraan adalah bahwa **Pertamax dan BBM subsidi diperkirakan tidak berubah**.
segments.tr: Relatively comforting news for many vehicle users is that **Pertamax and subsidized fuel are projected not to change**.

segments.src: BBM subsidi memang memiliki mekanisme penetapan harga yang berbeda, karena pemerintah ikut menentukan harga eceran serta menanggung selisihnya melalui anggaran negara.
segments.tr: Subsidized fuel indeed has a different pricing mechanism, because the government helps determine the retail price and covers the difference through the state budget.

segments.src: Meski demikian, proyeksi ini belum menjelaskan secara rinci alasan Pertamax dipertahankan.
segments.tr: Even so, this projection does not explain in detail the reasons Pertamax is maintained.

segments.src: Konsumen sebaiknya menunggu keterangan resmi dari Pertamina atau pemerintah sebelum mengambil kesimpulan.
segments.tr: Consumers should wait for official statements from Pertamina or the government before drawing conclusions.

segments.src: ## Sorotan pada Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah
segments.tr: ## Spotlight on the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea

segments.src: Selat Hormuz dan Laut Merah merupakan jalur pelayaran strategis bagi perdagangan energi dan barang dunia.
segments.tr: The Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea are strategic shipping lanes for world energy and goods trade.

segments.src: Ketika terjadi ketegangan di kawasan tersebut, pasar biasanya bereaksi terhadap risiko gangguan pasokan.
segments.tr: When tensions occur in the region, the market usually reacts to the risk of supply disruptions.

segments.src: Reaksi itu bisa berupa kenaikan harga minyak, kenaikan tarif asuransi kapal, atau perubahan rute pelayaran yang membuat waktu tempuh dan biaya kirim bertambah.
segments.tr: That reaction can be in the form of rising oil prices, higher ship insurance rates, or changes in shipping routes that increase travel time and shipping costs.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat pelaku usaha di bidang transportasi dan logistik ikut menyoroti perkembangan harga BBM.
segments.tr: This condition causes business actors in the transportation and logistics sectors to highlight fuel price developments.

segments.src: Bagi mereka, bahan bakar merupakan salah satu komponen biaya terbesar.
segments.tr: For them, fuel is one of the largest cost components.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga solar nonsubsidi seperti Dexlite berpotensi menambah beban operasional angkutan barang, terutama bagi perusahaan yang tidak menggunakan BBM bersubsidi.
segments.tr: The price increase of non-subsidized diesel such as Dexlite has the potential to add to the operational burden of freight transport, especially for companies that do not use subsidized fuel.

segments.src: ## Dampak yang Perlu Diantisipasi
segments.tr: ## Impacts to Anticipate

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang patut dicermati bila proyeksi ini terealisasi:
segments.tr: Several things worth watching if this projection is realized:

segments.src: 1. **Ongkos angkut barang:** biaya logistik yang naik dapat memengaruhi harga barang, meski besarnya tergantung sektor dan jarak pengiriman.
segments.tr: 1. **Freight transport costs:** rising logistics costs can affect goods prices, although the magnitude depends on the sector and delivery distance.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya operasional usaha kecil:** pelaku usaha yang bergantung pada armada kendaraan perlu meninjau ulang perhitungan biaya.
segments.tr: 2. **Small business operational costs:** business actors who rely on vehicle fleets need to review their cost calculations.

segments.src: 3. **Pengeluaran rumah tangga:** pengguna BBM nonsubsidi mungkin perlu menyesuaikan anggaran transportasi bulanan.
segments.tr: 3. **Household expenditures:** non-subsidized fuel users may need to adjust their monthly transportation budget.

segments.src: 4. **Inflasi:** kenaikan biaya transportasi dan logistik bisa memberi tekanan tambahan pada harga kebutuhan sehari-hari, meski dampak akhirnya masih bergantung pada kebijakan dan kondisi pasar.
segments.tr: 4. **Inflation:** rising transportation and logistics costs can put additional pressure on daily necessities prices, although the final impact still depends on policy and market conditions.

segments.src: ## Tips Menyikapi Kenaikan Harga BBM
segments.tr: ## Tips for Addressing Fuel Price Increases

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat dan pelaku usaha, ada beberapa langkah sederhana yang dapat dipertimbangkan:
segments.tr: For the community and business actors, there are several simple steps that can be considered:

segments.src: - **Pantau pengumuman resmi** Pertamina dan pemerintah agar tidak terpengaruh kabar yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official announcements** from Pertamina and the government so as not to be affected by unverified news.

segments.src: - **Gunakan BBM sesuai spesifikasi kendaraan.** Jangan berpindah jenis BBM hanya karena selisih harga bila tidak sesuai rekomendasi pabrikan.
segments.tr: - **Use fuel according to vehicle specifications.** Do not change fuel types just because of price differences if it does not match manufacturer recommendations.

segments.src: - **Rawat kendaraan secara berkala,** seperti mengecek tekanan ban dan filter udara, agar konsumsi bahan bakar tetap efisien.
segments.tr: - **Maintain the vehicle regularly,** such as checking tire pressure and air filters, so that fuel consumption remains efficient.

segments.src: - **Rencanakan perjalanan dan rute pengiriman** agar lebih hemat waktu dan bahan bakar.
segments.tr: - **Plan trips and shipping routes** to save time and fuel.

segments.src: - **Tinjau kembali anggaran usaha** bila BBM merupakan komponen biaya yang besar.
segments.tr: - **Review business budgets** if fuel is a major cost component.

segments.src: ## Catatan Penting
segments.tr: ## Important Note

segments.src: Angka-angka dalam artikel ini merupakan **proyeksi** yang dapat berubah mengikuti pergerakan harga minyak dunia, nilai tukar rupiah, dan kebijakan pemerintah.
segments.tr: The figures in this article are **projections** that can change following world oil price movements, rupiah exchange rates, and government policies.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan merujuk langsung pada pengumuman resmi Pertamina serta kanal resmi pemerintah untuk mengetahui harga yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer directly to Pertamina's official announcements and official government channels to find out the applicable prices.

segments.src: Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan saran keuangan atau investasi.
segments.tr: This article is prepared for general information purposes and does not constitute financial or investment advice.

id-20260927-news-3.title: Indonesian Delegation Walks Out During Netanyahu's Speech at UN General Assembly, 77 Nations Join in Leaving the Room

segments.src: Delegasi Indonesia meninggalkan ruang sidang Majelis Umum PBB ke-81 di New York ketika Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu naik podium untuk berpidato pada Kamis, 24 September 2026 waktu setempat.
segments.tr: The Indonesian delegation left the hall of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York when Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu took the podium to speak on Thursday, September 24, 2026, local time.

segments.src: Indonesia tidak sendiri.
segments.tr: Indonesia was not alone.

segments.src: Puluhan delegasi negara lain juga meninggalkan ruangan atau tidak hadir.
segments.tr: Dozens of delegations from other countries also left the room or were absent.

segments.src: Kementerian Luar Negeri (Kemlu) RI kemudian menjelaskan bahwa langkah itu merupakan bentuk solidaritas terhadap rakyat Palestina.
segments.tr: The Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) later explained that the move was a form of solidarity with the Palestinian people.

segments.src: ## Apa yang terjadi di ruang sidang
segments.tr: ## What happened in the courtroom

segments.src: Netanyahu mulai berpidato dalam rangkaian debat umum Sidang Majelis Umum PBB ke-81.
segments.tr: Netanyahu began his speech during the general debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly.

segments.src: Begitu ia berdiri di podium, sejumlah delegasi berjalan keluar, sehingga banyak kursi di aula tampak kosong.
segments.tr: As soon as he stood at the podium, a number of delegations walked out, leaving many seats in the hall looking empty.

segments.src: Kursi delegasi Indonesia termasuk di antaranya.
segments.tr: The seats of the Indonesian delegation were among them.

segments.src: Jumlah negara yang keluar berbeda-beda di setiap laporan:
segments.tr: The number of countries that walked out varies in each report:

segments.src: - Sejumlah media nasional, di antaranya IDX Channel dan AFU.id, menyebut **77 delegasi**, yaitu Indonesia bersama 76 negara lain.
segments.tr: - Several national media outlets, including IDX Channel and AFU.id, cited **77 delegations**, namely Indonesia along with 76 other countries.

segments.src: - Kantor berita Anadolu, yang dikutip banyak media, menyebut **sekitar 70 delegasi**. Hitungan itu berdasarkan tinjauan rekaman sidang.
segments.tr: - Anadolu news agency, cited by many media outlets, mentioned **around 70 delegations**. That count is based on a review of session recordings.

segments.src: Perbedaan angka ini umum terjadi.
segments.tr: This difference in numbers is common.

segments.src: Sebagian delegasi walkout saat pidato dimulai, sebagian lain memang tidak mengirim perwakilan.
segments.tr: Some delegations walked out when the speech began, while others did not send representatives at all.

segments.src: Pembaca sebaiknya melihat angka tersebut sebagai perkiraan.
segments.tr: Readers should view these figures as estimates.

segments.src: Catatan resmi PBB tidak memuat hitungan pasti.
segments.tr: Official UN records do not contain an exact count.

segments.src: ## Negara mana saja yang keluar
segments.tr: ## Which countries walked out

segments.src: Menurut hasil tinjauan Anadolu, delegasi yang meninggalkan ruangan atau tidak hadir antara lain Turki, Palestina, Tunisia, Suriah, Aljazair, Yaman, Mesir, Irak, Arab Saudi, Yordania, Iran, Qatar, Lebanon, Malaysia, Indonesia, dan Kuwait.
segments.tr: According to Anadolu's review, delegations that left the room or were absent included Turkey, Palestine, Tunisia, Syria, Algeria, Yemen, Egypt, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Iran, Qatar, Lebanon, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Kuwait.

segments.src: Dari luar kawasan Timur Tengah ada Spanyol, Brasil, Peru, Kuba, Nigeria, Ghana, Libya, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Oman, Niger, Madagaskar, Botswana, Bahama, Antigua dan Barbuda, serta Cabo Verde.
segments.tr: From outside the Middle East region were Spain, Brazil, Peru, Cuba, Nigeria, Ghana, Libya, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Oman, Niger, Madagascar, Botswana, the Bahamas, Antigua and Barbuda, and Cabo Verde.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, banyak negara tetap berada di ruangan.
segments.tr: Conversely, many countries remained in the room.

segments.src: Laporan yang sama menyebut Amerika Serikat, Jerman, Inggris, Prancis, Argentina, Hungaria, Kanada, Australia, dan sejumlah negara Eropa lain.
segments.tr: The same report mentioned the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Argentina, Hungary, Canada, Australia, and a number of other European countries.

segments.src: Tiongkok disebut hanya diwakili satu diplomat.
segments.tr: China was reportedly represented by only one diplomat.

segments.src: Peta ini menunjukkan bahwa sikap negara-negara anggota PBB terhadap isu Gaza masih beragam.
segments.tr: This map shows that UN member states' attitudes toward the Gaza issue remain diverse.

segments.src: ## Penjelasan Kemlu RI
segments.tr: ## Explanation from the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

segments.src: Juru bicara Kemlu RI, Vahd Nabyl A.
segments.tr: MoFA spokesperson Vahd Nabyl A.

segments.src: Mulachela, menjelaskan bahwa aksi tersebut dilakukan **"sebagai bentuk solidaritas kepada rakyat Palestina serta protes dan kecaman terhadap kejahatan kemanusiaan dan pelanggaran hukum internasional"** yang, menurut pemerintah Indonesia, dilakukan Israel terhadap warga Palestina di Gaza dan di Wilayah Palestina yang diduduki.
segments.tr: Mulachela, explained that the action was carried out **"as a form of solidarity with the Palestinian people as well as a protest and condemnation of crimes against humanity and violations of international law"** which, according to the Indonesian government, Israel has committed against Palestinians in Gaza and in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

segments.src: Beberapa hal penting dari penjelasan tersebut:
segments.tr: Several key points from the explanation:

segments.src: 1. **Bentuk protes yang damai dan lazim.** Walkout adalah praktik diplomatik yang sudah lama dikenal di forum internasional. Delegasi menyampaikan sikap politik tanpa mengganggu jalannya sidang.
segments.tr: 1. **A peaceful and common form of protest.** A walkout is a diplomatic practice long known in international forums. Delegations express their political stance without disrupting the proceedings.

segments.src: 2. **Konsisten dengan posisi lama Indonesia.** Indonesia sejak lama mendukung kemerdekaan Palestina dan menyuarakan penyelesaian konflik berdasarkan hukum internasional. Indonesia juga tidak memiliki hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel.
segments.tr: 2. **Consistent with Indonesia's longstanding position.** Indonesia has long supported Palestinian independence and voiced the resolution of the conflict based on international law. Indonesia also has no diplomatic relations with Israel.

segments.src: 3. **Bagian dari agenda yang lebih luas.** Delegasi Indonesia di UNGA81 dipimpin Menteri Luar Negeri Sugiono. Dalam rangkaian agenda itu, Indonesia dilaporkan mengumumkan bantuan sebesar USD 1,2 juta (sekitar Rp21,4 miliar) untuk UNRWA, badan PBB untuk pengungsi Palestina, serta menegaskan dukungan bagi pemulihan Gaza.
segments.tr: 3. **Part of a broader agenda.** The Indonesian delegation at UNGA81 was led by Foreign Minister Sugiono. In the series of agendas, Indonesia reportedly announced assistance of USD 1.2 million (around Rp21.4 billion) for UNRWA, the UN agency for Palestine refugees, and reaffirmed support for the recovery of Gaza.

segments.src: ## Tanggapan Netanyahu
segments.tr: ## Netanyahu's Response

segments.src: Menurut laporan media internasional, Netanyahu menanggapi delegasi yang keluar dari podium.
segments.tr: According to international media reports, Netanyahu responded to the delegations leaving the podium.

segments.src: Ia menyebut pihak yang meninggalkan ruangan sebagai "pengecut moral".
segments.tr: He called those who left the room "moral cowards".

segments.src: Dalam pidatonya, ia juga dilaporkan membela operasi militer Israel dan menolak tuduhan genosida di Gaza.
segments.tr: In his speech, he was also reported to have defended Israel's military operations and rejected accusations of genocide in Gaza.

segments.src: Pihak yang mengkritik Israel dan pihak yang membelanya memiliki pandangan yang sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: Those who criticize Israel and those who defend it hold vastly different views.

segments.src: Tuduhan kedua belah pihak ini sebaiknya dibaca sebagai pernyataan masing-masing, bukan sebagai kesimpulan hukum.
segments.tr: These mutual accusations should be read as respective statements, not as legal conclusions.

segments.src: Penilaian hukum atas situasi di Gaza masih menjadi pokok perkara di lembaga peradilan internasional.
segments.tr: A legal assessment of the situation in Gaza remains the subject of proceedings in international judicial institutions.

segments.src: ## Agenda berikutnya: pernyataan nasional Menlu Sugiono
segments.tr: ## Next agenda: Foreign Minister Sugiono's national statement

segments.src: Setelah walkout, perhatian beralih ke pernyataan nasional Indonesia dalam debat umum.
segments.tr: Following the walkout, attention shifted to Indonesia's national statement in the general debate.

segments.src: Menlu Sugiono dijadwalkan menyampaikan pernyataan itu pada 26 September, dengan tema perdamaian dunia.
segments.tr: Foreign Minister Sugiono is scheduled to deliver the statement on September 26, themed around world peace.

segments.src: Dalam berbagai kesempatan di UNGA81, Sugiono menyampaikan bahwa perdamaian harus disertai perubahan nyata bagi masyarakat Palestina, termasuk akses bantuan kemanusiaan dan berakhirnya kekerasan di Gaza.
segments.tr: In various occasions at UNGA81, Sugiono stated that peace must be accompanied by real change for the Palestinian people, including access to humanitarian aid and an end to the violence in Gaza.

segments.src: Pernyataan nasional adalah kesempatan bagi setiap negara untuk menyampaikan pandangan resmi tentang isu global, dari konflik bersenjata hingga kerja sama pembangunan.
segments.tr: A national statement is an opportunity for every country to convey its official views on global issues, from armed conflict to development cooperation.

segments.src: Isi lengkapnya bisa dibaca di situs resmi Kemlu RI dan di rilis resmi PBB.
segments.tr: The full content can be read on the official website of the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and in official UN releases.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi pembaca
segments.tr: ## What it means for readers

segments.src: - **Walkout bukan keputusan hukum.** Aksi ini adalah pesan politik dan tidak mengubah status hukum atau kebijakan apa pun.
segments.tr: - **A walkout is not a legal decision.** This action is a political message and does not change any legal status or policy.

segments.src: - **Posisi Indonesia tidak berubah.** Langkah ini sejalan dengan sikap Indonesia yang selama ini mendukung Palestina lewat jalur diplomasi dan bantuan kemanusiaan.
segments.tr: - **Indonesia's position remains unchanged.** This step aligns with Indonesia's stance of supporting Palestine through diplomatic channels and humanitarian aid.

segments.src: - **Dunia belum satu suara.** Ada negara yang keluar dan ada yang tetap duduk. Perbedaan itu menunjukkan bahwa isu Timur Tengah masih diperdebatkan.
segments.tr: - **The world is not yet of one voice.** Some countries walked out while others remained seated. This difference shows that the Middle East issue is still fiercely debated.

segments.src: - **Pantau sumber resmi.** Angka dan detail bisa berubah seiring verifikasi, jadi rujuklah keterangan resmi Kemlu RI dan PBB.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official sources.** Figures and details may change with verification, so refer to official statements from the Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the UN.

segments.tr: ## Source notes
